title: Barcelona in 1 day
text: A fantastic trip to cover Barcelona in one day! Our guide, Gaspar was funny, helpful, and very informative. It was a fun and engaging day trip, and we enjoyed it very much!
author: 344wenl

title: An awesome Romanian explaining Spain in the rain.
text:
We've had an awesome tour, large part thanks to our terrific tour guide Adrian.
He picked us up at our hotel early in the morning and showed us all of the great landmarks and interesting spots in Barcelona. Not only that; he had tons of interesting info which made it a very educational experience as well as an entertaining one.
All that while navigating the crazy Barcelona traffic, not even using any navigational equipment.
Plus credits for him sharing his umbrella with my nearly 80 year old mum.

We had a blast and highly recommend this tour for people (like us) with limited time.
author: Vacation48595224759

title: Alberto For The Win!
text: Alberto was FANTASTIC! Couldn’t have been a kinder, more patient, more knowledgeable guide. He even went out of his way to find trading cards for friends of ours back in the US. Total GEM of a person and AMAZING Tour Guide (and great driver which is also important). Would give 10-stars if we could. Thank you, Alberto!

title: A Fantastic Way to Experience Barcelona!
text: We had a fantastic time exploring Barcelona with David! He was knowledgeable, personable, and made our visits to La Boqueria, Sagrada Família, Park Güell, and the Gothic Quarter both fun and informative. We couldn’t have asked for a better guide and would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona!
